## 2026-08-16 · the connector that was never rekor's

Two defects wearing one face. The seam took only sync connectors, and every browser one is a promise — so a page passing the only shape it has got INVALID, its own plumbing reported as the document's guilt. Fixing it let me see the second: the rfc6962 climb lived inside a log client, so verifying a Bitcoin-anchored publisher meant installing rekor. Moving it out, I found rekor imports it for its OWN inclusion proof. It was never rekor's, and never only the connector's.
